correctness.rationale: The actual RESULT.md at frozen blob ff2af828... defines F_n correctly, degree d=n/2 for n=2^m. Setting c_j=binom(n,j)^2 binom(2(n-j),n), for 1<=j<=d the inner binomial is even, so 4|c_j. Legendre binary digit sums give v_2(c_0)=1 and v_2(c_d)=2. Thus G_n(X)=X^dF_n(1/X)/2 has integral coefficients, odd leading coefficient, all other coefficients even, and constant coefficient exactly divisible by 2, not 4. It is Eisenstein at 2. Because c_0!=0, reciprocal irreducibility transfers to F_n. Applies for every m>=1, not other indices. Independent exact binomial-valuation checks covered n=2..128, not used for all m.
